name: Luuk de Vries
bio:
Luuk's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during a high school field trip to a local composite manufacturing facility. Mesmerized by the intricate processes involved in creating lightweight, high-strength materials, he immediately pursued a vocational degree in composite engineering. His attention to detail and relentless pursuit of perfection quickly made him a standout student, earning him an internship with a small racing team specializing in Formula Ford. 

At Nostalgia Racing, Luuk is responsible for the design, fabrication, and repair of composite components for the team's vintage race cars. He approaches each task with meticulous precision, ensuring that every part meets the highest standards of quality and performance. Luuk's innovative approach to problem-solving and his ability to adapt to the ever-changing demands of the sport make him a valuable asset to the team. His ability to visualize complex geometries and translate them into tangible components sets him apart.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted with a slight wave
physical.description: Luuk is of average height with a lean build and a perpetually focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with sketches and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on surfaces when deep in thought.
Insists on using only Dutch-made tools and materials whenever possible.
